reviews.title: Great budget case
reviews.comment:
I recently purchased the Okinos Micro ATX case with 4 × 120mm ARGB fans, and overall I’m really happy with it. For the price, it offers excellent value and delivers a clean, modern look that fits perfectly with a gaming setup. The included ARGB fans are a nice bonus and add a lot of visual appeal right out of the box.
One of the best parts of this case was how easy it made the building process. Everything felt well thought out, with enough space to work comfortably even in a Micro ATX form factor. Cable management was straightforward, and I didn’t feel cramped or frustrated at any point while putting my PC together.
The airflow also seems solid thanks to the included fans, and the case doesn’t feel cheaply made despite the affordable price. It strikes a nice balance between functionality and aesthetics, which isn’t always easy to find in this price range. The tempered glass panel is a nice touch as well, letting you show off your build.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend this case to anyone looking for a budget-friendly option that still delivers on looks and ease of use. It made my PC build a smooth experience, and for the price, it’s hard to beat what you’re getting.
reviews.author: Barbara Torres

reviews.title: Good quality case for a great price!
reviews.comment: Purchase this case to build my Wife's budget PC, her first time having her own PC for gaming. Most parts in the build were repurposed from an old build save the Case and PSU. Love the fact the case came with 4 PWM/ARGB fans of good quality. 120mm AIO, M-ATX Mobo ASRock B550M-C, Ryzen 7 3800X CPU, 64GB G-Skill Ram, MSI RTX 3060 Ventus X3 12GB OC. WD Black 2 TB Gen 3 NVMe M.2 drive. Was very surprised the good quality for the low price of the case. Great air flow, temps are great. 120MM AIO is a perfect fit for this small case. fans work great, very quiet too. All ARGB working as it should with Mobo. Case is very easy to build in and cable manage. Add 2 additional Cooler Master Cycle Flow case fans at the top for exhaust. This is a no brainer for a M-ATX form factor build. I would recommend this case without issue.
reviews.author: anndmsantos

reviews.title: Great value overall
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1pDfi6JLoL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61reT5btIgL._SY256.jpg For $60 this mATX case is probably among the best cases currently on the market. The side panel is plenty spacious for cable management. I had to spend some time and effort shoving excess cables into whatever space I could find in the bottom compartment and had just the right amount of space in the end. Installing everything else was easy. There's plenty of space to work with and plenty of ways to snake cables around to the motherboard. Four ARGB fans are pre-installed and the overall airflow is excellent.
The picture and video are the reason why I docked one star. I first ordered this case on Sep. 27 and it came with a damaged corner. A replacement arrived on Sep. 29 with a malfunctioning rear exhaust fan. I confirmed the fan was malfunctioning by swapping to an older fan and it worked fine. Amazon's customer support gave me credit towards ordering a fan replacement and the rest is history. Let this review be a cautionary tale to fully inspect the case you get before fully committing to installing everything.

reviews.title: Best Case for the price
reviews.comment: I used this case to build a pc for a very close friend of mine and he really liked the way it looks. The building experience in this case was really good and very spacious for cable management. I could tell they used high quality materials and the 4 pre installed case fans was a really nice touch. For $70 this case is a steal and I’d highly recommend getting this. Will buy this again for my personal build later in the future
reviews.author: Brandin

reviews.title: Great ARGB PC Case for budget builders!
reviews.comment:
This pc case looks nice build quality is pretty good as usual like other Okinos cases, I had a great time building a PC in it, cable management is pretty decent so you can manage cables well even if you have a full cable extension set, the ARGB modes are pretty good offering a wide variety of modes for you to choose from, it does use 3 pin 5v ARGB so you can connect any ARGB fan in the market to it and it will work, it only has 4 headers so you may need to buy an ARGB splitter so you can connect more than 4 fans.
Wanting an ARGB pc case for under $60 (at the time of writing this, it’s $56), this is the best bang for a buck budget case with the cool lighting fans
